description: Diger på 4cm kort is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klimadatastyrelsen. 'Diger on 4cm card' is nationwide map in target ratio 1:25,000 over dikes in Denmark. This edition is the last one revised prior to that of 1 July 1992. The map has been prepared for the Danish Agency for Culture and Palaces and is used for the registration of protected stone and earth walls. Coverage: Klimadatastyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "Digs on 4cm card" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klimadatastyrelsen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
